title: Notice regarding Special Courts on 27.11.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 26/11/2026
It is hereby notified that on 27/11/2026;
dated 27.10.2026.

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 26/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 27/11/2026;
1. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice Mr. Justice Manash
Ranjan Pathak and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S. Kariel would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
2. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble the Acting
Chief Justice Mr. Justice Manash Ranjan Pathak would sit Single
and take up the matters as per Roster.
3. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. S. Supehia and Hon’ble
Ms. Justice Gita Gopi would sit in Special Division Bench and take
up the notified matter/s.
4. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 3 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
A. S. Supehia and Hon’ble Mr. Justice R. T. Vachhani would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
5. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen and Hon’ble
Ms. Justice Nisha M. Thakore would sit in Special Division Bench
and take up the notified matter/s.
6. After the work of Division Bench is over, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Ilesh J. Vora would sit Single and take up the notified matters.
7. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 3 above, Hon’ble
Ms. Justice Gita Gopi would sit Single and take up the matters as
per Roster.
8. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nirzar S. Desai would sit Single
and take up the notified matters.
9. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 1 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Nikhil S. Kariel would sit Single and take up the matters as per
Roster.
10. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 5 above, Hon’ble Ms. Justice
Nisha M. Thakore would sit Single and take up the notified
matter/s.
11. At 02:30 PM, Hon’ble Mr. Justice D. N. Ray would take up the
Specially assigned Arbitration matters as per the Notification
dated 27.10.2026.
12. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 4 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
R. T. Vachhani would sit Single and take up the matters as per
Roster.
13. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai would
sit Single and take up the notified matters.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar Judicial
